title: When to Retrieve, When to Stay: Uncertainty-Aware Temporal Evidence Allocation for Streaming Video-LLMs
title_zh: 何时检索，何时停留：面向流式 Video-LLM 的不确定性感知时序证据分配
abstract_en: Streaming video understanding requires Video Large Language Models (Video-LLMs) to reason over continuous visual streams under causal constraints. As the visual history grows, a bounded visual?processing budget requires evidence selection that balances temporal recency with query relevance. Recent-only selection excludes potentially relevant historical evidence, whereas Semantic-only retrieval can displace useful recent context when relevance scores are ambiguous. We introduce WRWS (When to Retrieve, When to Stay), a training-free framework for uncertainty-adaptive evidence allocation. A lightweight external vision-language encoder scores query relevance across the observed history, while an adaptive allocation module uses the normalized entropy of the similarity distribution as a proxy for retrieval uncertainty. WRWS favors semantic retrieval when relevance cues are reliable and strengthens the recency prior under uncertainty. Following a retrieve-first, encode-later pipeline, WRWS selects evidence before target-model visual encoding, such that only the selected observations are processed by the costly target Video-LLM. Experiments across four Video-LLM families and multiple model scales demonstrate competitive accuracy on StreamingBench and OVO-Bench. In our efficiency evaluation, WRWS reduces average vision-to-answer time to 47.93% of the state-of-the-art method. Code will be released.
abstract_zh: 流式视频理解要求 Video-LLM 在因果约束下持续处理视觉流，并在有限视觉处理预算内选择证据。仅保留近期内容可能遗漏历史相关信息，而仅依赖语义检索则可能在相关性不明确时牺牲有用的近期上下文。本文提出无需训练的 WRWS（When to Retrieve, When to Stay）框架，通过轻量级外部视觉语言编码器评估历史观测与查询的相关性，并利用相似度分布的归一化熵估计检索不确定性。当相关性线索可靠时，WRWS 偏向语义检索；当不确定性较高时，则增强时间新近性先验。该方法采用“先检索、后编码”流程，在目标模型进行视觉编码前完成证据选择，从而仅处理被选中的观测。跨四类 Video-LLM 及多种模型规模的实验表明，WRWS 在 StreamingBench 和 OVO-Bench 上取得有竞争力的准确率；效率评估中，其平均从视觉输入到答案的耗时仅为当前最优方法的 47.93%。代码将公开。
key_points_zh: 提出无需训练的 WRWS，根据检索相关性分布熵动态决定“检索”还是“保留近期证据”。
相关性线索可靠时优先选择历史语义证据，不确定时强化时间新近性先验，缓解两类证据选择策略的局限。
采用先检索后编码，仅对选中观测执行昂贵的目标 Video-LLM 视觉编码，降低推理成本。
在四类 Video-LLM、多个模型规模及 StreamingBench、OVO-Bench 上验证了具有竞争力的准确率。
平均视觉到答案延迟降至当前最优方法的 47.93%，体现出显著效率优势。

llm_assessment.comment: A strong streaming Video-LLM systems contribution that adaptively balances recency and retrieval uncertainty to reduce visual latency under bounded budgets.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该工作面向受限预算下的流式视频智能体，自适应平衡时间新近性与检索不确定性并显著降低视觉延迟。
